latest.one_line: Major crypto assets posted slight gains today as traders waited for the Federal Reserve rate decision.
moved: Bitcoin rose 1.3% to $64,279 ahead of the Federal Reserve rate announcement.
Ethereum picked up 1.6% to $1,907 following news of new Morgan Stanley exchange-traded products.
Solana edged up 0.5% to $73.63, trailing larger assets after a weak week.
latest.traded: Prices fell sharply on July 28 and then bounced back up on July 29. This is a rebound, meaning buyers bought the drop near lower support levels.
latest.versus_yesterday: This is the first daily note. Prices have turned upward from yesterday's sharp pullback.
